features.notes: Fixed mcp.go::makeToolHandler: presence-check declared params (absent key OR explicit null), return structured 'missing required parameter(s): <names>' in declaration order BEFORE engine call. Type-agnostic (string+int proven). 6 new tests in mcp_param_binding_test.go pass -count=20 (4 reject cases + 2 regression: all-present + legacy positional, both invoke real engine returning 'Hello, World!'). @route AUDIT: confirmed-safe, NOT same bug — parseNamedArgs/parseArgsWithNamesEx zero-pad omitted typed params via zeroValueForType (''/0/false/[]/{}), never nil→Unit for known types. That's the deliberate v0.21.0 m-serveapi-get-query-shadow design (lets handler self-validate). Added TestRouteParamOmission_ZeroPadsNotNil regression guard. serve-api.md documents both behaviors + why they diverge.
